entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one transparent sprite asset sheet of FIVE separated HEADS of the SAME character for a 2D isometric game, matching the approved ink-and-cel-shaded illustration reference. Input image is STYLE AND CHARACTER IDENTITY REFERENCE only. Character cra: FIRST ROW FIRST COLUMN: female archer with fair skin, ash blond hair, large moss olive green hood, pointed ears, green eyes. Hood must remain part of the head silhouette. Match this specific reference character. Head cutoff at the base of the neck, no shoulders or torso, no weapons or props. Precise layout: landscape 1536x1024, three equal columns and two equal rows; each head centered with 12% clear padding, NO head touches another. TOP LEFT: three quarter FRONT facing RIGHT (both eyes visible); TOP MIDDLE: true SIDE PROFILE facing RIGHT (one eye); TOP RIGHT: straight FRONT; BOTTOM LEFT: three quarter BACK facing LEFT (mostly back of hair/hood, small side of face); BOTTOM MIDDLE: true BACK no face visible. BOTTOM RIGHT completely empty transparent. Same size, proportions, hairstyle, clothing, colors and light direction in all five views. Fine dark hand ink outlines, warm muted parchment highlights, clear cel shaded materials, detailed but game readable. Real transparent alpha background, absolutely NO colored backdrop, gradients, floor, shadows outside heads, labels, borders, watermark or additional characters. These are isolated modular head pieces, NOT full bodies.
